name: Bendemeer East
summary: East of Bendemeer MRT toward Kallang Bahru — NEL-adjacent mid-town living with denser HDB/condo mix and practical CBD hops.
body: Bendemeer East is the shortlist when North-East Line adjacency and mid-town value matter more than riverside branding. The pocket sits east of Bendemeer station toward Kallang Bahru industrial-residential edges; housing mixes mature HDB with selective condo stock. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops without Bugis tourist crush. Watch-outs: peak NEL loads, FOC / chute treatment notices, and older-block variance. Compare with the wider Bendemeer entity for station-core framing, Kallang Bahru for quieter industrial-adjacent nights, and Bugis South when denser central energy wins.
